description.zh: 整周格子视图（周一到周日 × 第 1-12 节，带午休 / 晚休分隔）+ 当天课程卡片，全部按「第几周」自动过滤（4-18 周、6-9 周、只上第 8 周这种都能认）。还能记放假（国庆、寒暑假）和调休补课日（周六照周四的课表上），放假日自动不排课、当天直接说「放假中」，补课日照排。上面一张可折叠月历，有课的日子点小圆点。数据只存本机。
description.en: A class timetable: weekly grid view and per-day cards, filtered by teaching weeks (e.g. week 4-18, week 6-9, only week 8). Holidays (National Day, winter break) and make-up days (a Saturday following another weekday's timetable) can be recorded; holidays automatically clear classes. A collapsible month calendar on top with dots on days that have classes. Data stays on device.

description.zh: 今天上什么课、这一周的课、下一节课、课程清单、设置
description.en: Today, this week, next class, course list, config
